intro.text: A Terris youth in Elendel's Village during Wax's teenage years, and a Twinborn who is both a Coinshot and a Brute.

items.text: Around 314 Forch began setting fires in the Village and burned down the Terris dining lodge. Wax found oil flasks in his chest, smoky clothes and boots matching the tracks. The elders confronted Forch, punished him and asked the other youths to befriend him; finding that too lenient, Wax sent his findings to the city constables anonymously.

A month on, Forch slipped out to drink with Telsin, Idashwy and Kwashim. Once they were too drunk to notice, he kidnapped a young boy and brought him back to an old storage dormitory, where he began cutting him open, planning to burn the place afterwards. Wax followed; Forch beat him and threw him out a window.

Wax survived the fall and returned. As they fought over a bullet, Wax fired its primer and struck Forch in the eye, killing him. The Village resented Wax for bringing violence into it, and he soon left.

appearance.text: A tall young man in his late teens.

personality.text: Quiet, seemingly emotionless and nearly friendless. Clever enough to plan false alibis but careless with small details, he is fascinated by fire and violence and feels no remorse.
